title: Event Brand and Experiential (index)
summary: A consistent experience from the invitation to the stage.
overview: I directed event identities and creative systems across customer conferences, field events, and executive experiences. The work connected stage visuals, signage, speaker presentations, digital campaigns, and production partners. This page has become an index: the event work for each company now has its own page, linked below, with the full media that used to live here. Nothing has been removed -- every image and video from this page's four sections is still published, just moved to its own case study.
